name: pnv-panel
install: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y php-cli php-sqlite3 php-gd php-mbstring php-curl && mkdir -p temp phpqrcode/cache

terminals.name: PHP Server
terminals.description: PHP built-in dev server for pnv-panel on port 8080. Recreates the untracked temp/ and phpqrcode/cache/ dirs before serving so QR generation stays warning-free.
